logger.doc:name: Log Pickup
logger.message: #['[Correlation ID: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ '] Consumed reorder event for SKU: ' ++ vars.queuePayload.sku]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert PENDING Reorder Event
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO reorder_events (event_id, sku, warehouse_code, supplier_code, available_qty, reorder_point, reorder_qty, source, status, attempts, correlation_id, raised_at) VALUES (:eventId, :sku, :warehouseCode, :supplierCode, :availableQty, :reorderPoint, :reorderQty, :source, 'PENDING', 1, :correlationId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ eventId: vars.queuePayload.eventId, sku: vars.queuePayload.sku, warehouseCode: vars.queuePayload.warehouseCode, supplierCode: vars.queuePayload.supplierCode, availableQty: vars.queuePayload.availableQtyAllLocations, reorderPoint: vars.queuePayload.reorderPoint, reorderQty: vars.queuePayload.reorderQty, source: vars.queuePayload.source, correlationId: vars.correlationId }]

db:insert.doc:name: Persist Purchase Order
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO purchase_orders (po_number, supplier_code, supplier_po_no, sku, warehouse_code, ordered_qty, unit_cost, status, idempotency_key, raised_at) VALUES (:poNumber, :supplierCode, :supplierPoNo, :sku, :warehouseCode, :orderedQty, :unitCost, 'RAISED', :idempotencyKey, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ poNumber: vars.internalPoNumber, supplierCode: vars.queuePayload.supplierCode, supplierPoNo: vars.supplierResult.responseBody.supplierPoNumber default vars.supplierResult.responseBody.existingSupplierPoNumber, sku: vars.queuePayload.sku, warehouseCode: vars.queuePayload.warehouseCode, orderedQty: vars.queuePayload.reorderQty, unitCost: vars.queuePayload.unitCost, idempotencyKey: vars.supplierIdempotencyKey }]

db:update.doc:name: Update Event to PO_RAISED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE reorder_events SET status = 'PO_RAISED', po_number = :poNumber, resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id = :eventId

db:update.doc:name: Update Event to FAILED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE reorder_events SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = :reason, resolved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id = :eventId
